format.notes: Dry voice only. No reverb, music or effects; peaks under -3 dBFS; trim silence to ~50 ms. Effects are added in the mix.

archivist.role: M.E.G. archivist narrating the recovered tape (same narrator in every episode)
archivist.voice: Adult, neutral-to-low voice, any gender. Flat, clinical, measured, like reading an incident report aloud. Even pace, no drama. Must be the SAME voice as Ep01's archivist.

wanderer.role: The unidentified wanderer holding the camera. Fell out of reality into Level 0.
wanderer.voice: Young man, early 20s, ordinary voice. Frightened, breathy, speaking quietly to himself — close to the microphone. Never theatrical.

familiar.role: A familiar voice calling from somewhere in the walls — it sounds like the wanderer's mother. (It is not her.)
familiar.voice: Middle-aged woman, warm, gentle, slightly worried; calling out softly as if looking for her son in a big house.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 录像编号 000-A。拍摄者身份不明。录像在基地阿尔法外被回收。
lines.en: Tape 000-A. Camera operator unidentified. Recovered outside Base Alpha.
lines.tts_text: 录像编号，零零零，A。拍摄者身份不明。录像在基地阿尔法外被回收。
lines.direction: Clinical, even. Short pause after each sentence.

lines.speaker: wanderer
lines.subtitle: 「……这是……哪儿？」
lines.en: “…Where… is this?”
lines.tts_text: ……这是……哪儿？
lines.direction: Just woke up, groggy and confused, very quiet. Long pauses.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: Level 0，「门槛」。绝大多数人，都是从这里开始的。
lines.en: Level 0, “Threshold”. Almost everyone starts here.
lines.tts_text: 零层，「门槛」。绝大多数人，都是从这里开始的。
lines.direction: Report tone; a slight weight on 绝大多数人.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 潮湿的地毯，发霉的黄色墙纸，永不停歇的日光灯嗡鸣。这片迷宫绵延数英里。
lines.en: Wet carpet. Mouldy yellow wallpaper. The endless hum of fluorescent lights. The maze goes on for miles.
lines.tts_text: 潮湿的地毯，发霉的黄色墙纸，永不停歇的日光灯嗡鸣。这片迷宫，绵延数英里。
lines.direction: Listing, measured, slightly slower.

lines.speaker: wanderer
lines.subtitle: 「有人吗？」
lines.en: “Hello? Anyone?”
lines.tts_text: 有人吗？
lines.direction: Calling out, but not loud — afraid of being heard. Uncertain.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 没有人看着的时候，这里的布局会自己改变。
lines.en: When no one is watching, the layout changes on its own.
lines.tts_text: 没有人看着的时候，这里的布局，会自己改变。
lines.direction: Flat, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: wanderer
lines.subtitle: 「……刚才这里有门的。」
lines.en: “…There was a door here.”
lines.tts_text: ……刚才，这里有门的。
lines.direction: Whispered disbelief, breath catching.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 我们称之为「外围位移」。它可能抹掉你好几天的进度。
lines.en: We call it the Peripheral Shift. It can erase days of progress.
lines.tts_text: 我们称之为，「外围位移」。它可能抹掉你好几天的进度。
lines.direction: Report tone.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 柱厅。选定一个方向，一直走下去。不要回头——身后的路会变。
lines.en: The Pillars. Pick a heading and keep to it. Don’t look back — the way behind you shifts.
lines.tts_text: 柱厅。选定一个方向，一直走下去。不要回头，身后的路，会变。
lines.direction: Instructional, calm, a little slower on 不要回头.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 坑洞。没有人知道，掉下去的人最后去了哪里。
lines.en: The Holes. No one knows where the people who fall in end up.
lines.tts_text: 坑洞。没有人知道，掉下去的人，最后去了哪里。
lines.direction: Quiet, flat.

lines.speaker: familiar
lines.subtitle: 「……你在哪儿啊？」
lines.en: “…Where are you, sweetheart?”
lines.tts_text: ……你在哪儿啊？
lines.direction: Calling gently from another room, a mother looking for her child. Warm. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: wanderer
lines.subtitle: 「……妈？」
lines.en: “…Mom?”
lines.direction: Barely audible, hopeful and scared at once.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 你会听见熟悉的声音在叫你。不要回应。
lines.en: You will hear familiar voices calling you. Do not answer.
lines.tts_text: 你会听见熟悉的声音在叫你。不要回应。
lines.direction: Cold, firm. Slight pause before 不要回应.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 停电区。地上的液体没过脚踝。朝第一束光，或者嗡鸣声的方向走。
lines.en: A blackout zone. Ankle-deep fluid. Walk towards the first light, or the buzzing.
lines.tts_text: 停电区。地上的液体没过脚踝。朝第一束光，或者嗡鸣声的方向走。
lines.direction: Instructional, steady.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 如果墙壁开始变红，地毯变得黏稠——立刻掉头。
lines.en: If the walls start turning red and the carpet gets sticky — turn back. Immediately.
lines.tts_text: 如果墙壁开始变红，地毯变得黏稠，立刻掉头。
lines.direction: Still flat, but faster on 立刻掉头 — the only urgent line the archivist has.

lines.speaker: wanderer
lines.subtitle: 「不不不不……」
lines.en: “No no no no…”
lines.tts_text: 不不不不……
lines.direction: Panicked, breathless, running.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 拱门区。整个层级最稳定的地方。你可以在这里休息一下。
lines.en: The Arches. The most stable part of the level. You can rest here.
lines.tts_text: 拱门区。整个层级最稳定的地方。你可以在这里，休息一下。
lines.direction: Softer than usual — almost kind.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 出口：找到一面闪烁的墙。然后，穿过去。
lines.en: The exit: find a wall that flickers. Then walk through it.
lines.tts_text: 出口，找到一面闪烁的墙。然后，穿过去。
lines.direction: Report tone, a beat before 穿过去.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: Level 1，「宜居地带」。
lines.en: Level 1, the “Habitable Zone”.
lines.tts_text: 一层，「宜居地带」。
lines.direction: Report tone.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 和你一起进来的人，你再也不会见到他们。
lines.en: Whoever came in with you, you will never see them again.
lines.tts_text: 和你一起进来的人，你再也不会见到他们。
lines.direction: Quiet, final. The closing line of the episode.
